feedback: The checkout page takes too long to load, especially during evening hours.
I was charged twice for one order and support has not resolved it yet.
The new dashboard looks clean, but finding past orders is confusing.
Customer support replied quickly and fixed my delivery address issue.
The mobile app crashes when I try to apply a discount code.
Delivery arrived two days late, but the product quality was excellent.
Please add order tracking notifications so I do not need to contact support.
The app is easy to use and checkout was fast this time.
